_readme: Topic queue for the blog engine, rewritten 2026-11-08 (op #1549) after Ian's direction in the [copperline] blog direction issue. The monthly run (scripts/plan-month.mjs) fills one weekly slot per Monday: local events first on odd weeks, customer questions first on even weeks, each falling back to the other. Events come from scripts/research-events.mjs, not from this file. Questions below are a seed list for Ian to edit: add real questions customers ask at the register or on the phone. A question is skipped once its post exists on master or has an open PR. The old queue is in _archive/2026-11-08/backlog.json.

questions.question: Do you serve breakfast all day?
questions.notes: The FAQ answers this (breakfast served all day). Short post: say yes, then what that means in practice using the menu. Do not add anything the FAQ does not say.

questions.question: Do you sell gift cards?
questions.notes: The FAQ answers this (any denomination, at the register or by phone). Best slotted in late November or December. Ask Ian if there is any holiday offer before mentioning one.

questions.question: How far ahead do I need to order breakfast for an office meeting?
questions.notes: Grounded in the catering facts (lead time, per-event quote for breakfast, pick-up or drop-off, quote builder). Do not quote breakfast prices; the priced packages are lunch and dinner buffets.

questions.question: What is on the kids' menu?
questions.notes: Grounded: children's menu for under 12, $7.50, high chairs and booster seats.

questions.question: Can I get takeout or delivery?
questions.notes: Grounded: call for takeout, DoorDash for delivery (FAQ). Anything about wait times or packaging needs Ian.

questions.question: What can I order if I am vegetarian or gluten-free?
questions.notes: Use only what the FAQ's dietary answer and the menu descriptions state. Anything about kitchen practices or cross-contact must be a Please confirm question, never a claim.

questions.question: Can we reserve a table for a group of ten?
questions.notes: Grounded: no reservations. Any advice about quieter times or seating needs Ian; ask, do not guess.
